prompt: My transaction has been stuck pending for hours and I can't send any more. How do I fix this?
expected: Instructs the user to send a new transaction with the exact same nonce and a higher gas fee to replace the stuck transaction.
actual: To fix your stuck transaction, you need to send a new transaction using the exact same nonce as the pending one, but with a higher gas fee (specifically a higher maxPriorityFeePerGas and maxFeePerGas). This will replace the stuck transaction. You can even send a 0 ETH transfer to your own address just to clear the nonce. In wallets like MetaMask, the 'Speed up' or 'Cancel' buttons do this automatically.

prompt: I'm bridging some ETH from Arbitrum back to Mainnet but it says it will take 7 days. Is this a bug?
expected: Explains that a 7-day withdrawal period is normal for Optimistic rollups due to their security model, and suggests third-party fast bridges as an alternative.
actual: No, this is not a bug. Arbitrum is an Optimistic rollup, and the 7-day withdrawal period is a fundamental part of its security model to allow time for fraud proofs. If you need your funds faster and are willing to pay a fee, you can use a third-party fast bridge (like Hop or Across) which bypasses the waiting period, though it involves smart contract risk.
